I've replied to Dana in their DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

- **Source:** Dana posted it in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, the day after the amendment was signed. Their first message said 180, and a few minutes later they corrected it to 185.
- **What's missing:** The amendment file itself isn't in the shared files, so that chat is the only source I have. I told Dana that June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if the deck needs to cite the document.
- **Access:** Dana is a member of #north-team, so the answer uses only what Dana can see. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so sharing it didn't need approval.
